# Korean Martial Arts Academy Nepal (KMAA)

> A martial arts academy at Bishal Chowk, Lalitpur, Nepal, teaching Muay Thai, kickboxing and Taekwondo to all levels, from complete beginners to athletes. Morning and evening classes. To book a trial class, call +977 985-1233728.

## Classes

- **Muay Thai**: punches, kicks, knees, elbows, pad work and conditioning. Coach: Santosh Ghalan. Mornings 7:00–8:30 AM, evenings 6:00–7:20 PM.
- **Kickboxing**: combinations, footwork, balance, timing and fitness. Coach: Santosh Ghalan.
- **Taekwondo**: dynamic kicking, forms, flexibility, focus and discipline. Coach: Master Raju Shrestha, 5th Dan Black Belt. Mornings 5:00–6:00 AM and 6:00–7:00 AM, evenings 4:00–5:00 PM and 5:00–6:00 PM.

## Common questions

- **Do I need experience?** No. All levels are welcome; beginners train alongside experienced students.
- **How do I book a trial class?** Call +977 985-1233728; the coaches help you choose a discipline and session.
- **Kickboxing times?** Call the academy to confirm kickboxing sessions.
